title: Replicate route settings in Library Profiles
summary: Implements the Library Profiles route and size editor described in docs/implementation/library-profile-routing-size-replication-plan.md, keeping the existing backend LibraryProfiles override model authoritative.
reason: The operator requested execution of the plan to make Libraries closely mirror the current Settings route and size controls.
behavior_before: Library Profiles exposed route and size overrides through a generic flat editor grid, even though Settings presents those same controls as a route/height/bucket policy builder.
behavior_after: Library Profiles renders a Settings-like route and size editor for per-library route overrides while preserving inherited values, explicit override state, designation filtering, staged LibraryProfiles JSON, and backend Preview/Save authority.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe .\ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed only due unrelated pre-existing ops/release/changes/unreleased/MP-CHANGE-2026-0605-010.json missing date_completed
rollback_plan: Restore settingsLibraries.js to the generic editor grid, remove routePolicyModel.js and its script tag if unused, remove Library route CSS additions and focused tests, refresh generated summaries, and rerun the targeted WebView/settings validation.
notes: Implementation must not change PowerShell route policy, saved config schema, FFmpeg behavior, or backend LibraryProfiles validation semantics.
